bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 4
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, CCA4102, request a ground power unit, our APU is unserviceable.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4102, Delivery, roger, GPU will be connected in 5 minutes.

questions.question: What service does CCA4102 need?
questions.explanation: 飞行员明确说 'request a ground power unit, our APU is unserviceable'，即因 APU 故障申请地面电源车，故选 C。加水、推出、加油服务对话中均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN6490, Wuhan Ground, taxi via B1, E and T6 to holding point of RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Taxi via B1, E and T6 to holding point, RWY36R, CSN6490.

questions.question: How should CSN6490 taxi?

options.A: B6, E, T1 to holding point, RWY36R
options.B: B1, E, T6 to holding point, RWY36R
options.C: B1, E, T6 to holding point, RWY36L
options.D: B1, T6, E to holding point, RWY36R

questions.explanation: 管制员指令 'taxi via B1, E and T6 to holding point of RWY36R'，飞行员也正确复述，滑行路线为 B1→E→T6、跑道 36R，故选 B。A 项滑行道编号错，C 项跑道号错，D 项顺序错。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSH9362, we have a cargo fire indication, we have discharged the fire bottles, but the warning is still on, request immediate landing.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSH9362, Wuhan Approach, roger PANPAN, say your intentions.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Request priority landing RWY36R, CSH9362.

questions.question: Why is CSH9362 making an urgency call?

options.A: Because the fire bottles are empty.
options.B: Because of a cargo fire warning.
options.C: Because the engine is on fire.
options.D: Because there is smoke in the cabin.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 PANPAN 的原因是 'we have a cargo fire indication'，即货舱火警指示，故选 B。灭火瓶已释放但警告仍在（A 项说法本身错误），发动机起火和客舱冒烟对话中均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: HDA305, Wuhan Control, follow XS-11A Arrival, expect ILS approach RWY36L, descend to 2700m on QNH1006, Info K.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, XS-12A Arrival, ILS approach RWY36L, HDA305.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: HDA305, negative, XS-11A Arrival, descend to 2700m on QNH1006, Info K.

questions.question: What mistake did the pilot make during the readback?

options.A: The pilot was wrong about the altitude and missed the Arrival procedure.
options.B: The pilot was wrong about the runway and missed altitude.
options.C: The pilot was wrong about the callsign and missed Info.
options.D: The pilot was wrong about the Arrival procedure and missed altitude and Info.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令是 'XS-11A Arrival... descend to 2700m on QNH1006, Info K'，飞行员复述成 'XS-12A Arrival'（进场程序念错），且漏掉了下降高度 2700m 和情报通播 Info K，故选 D。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, BAW5180, we have traffic indication at 12 o'clock, 15nm, 500m above us, it's descending, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW5180, it's a military formation, maintain 10100m, expect climb in 5 minutes.

questions.question: Where is the military traffic?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'traffic indication at 12 o'clock, 15nm, 500m above us, it's descending'，管制员确认是 military formation，即 12 点钟方向、15 海里、上方 500 米、正在下降，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1331, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1331, cleared for takeoff, RWY18, surface wind 250 degrees 9m/s gusting to 20m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 119.0.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 119.0, CCA1331.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA1331, 600m climbing. We struck a flock of birds, the right engine is vibrating severely, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1331, roger, continue runway heading, turn right after 1000m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue runway heading, turn right after 1000m, request fire service upon landing, CCA1331.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, CCA1331, fire service will be ready for you. Contact Approach 125.0.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 125.0, thanks, CCA1331.

questions.question: What is the wind condition when CCA1331 takes off?
questions.explanation: 管制员通报 'surface wind 250 degrees 9m/s gusting to 20m/s'，阵风达 20m/s，属阵性大风天气，故选 A。并非轻风、顺风或静风。

questions.question: What happened to CCA1331 during takeoff?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'We struck a flock of birds, the right engine is vibrating severely'，即起飞爬升中遭遇鸟击导致右发剧烈振动，故选 B。是振动而非发动机起火。

questions.question: Which frequency should CCA1331 call finally?
questions.explanation: 注意题目问的是最后联系的频率。起飞前指令是 'contact Departure on 119.0'（D 项，是干扰项），但返场时管制员最后指令 'Contact Approach 125.0'，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2701, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 6nm left of track, expect rejoin the route at OBLIK.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 6nm left of track, CES2701.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CES2701, we have weather indication 40nm ahead of us, request deviate to the left for 12nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2701, negative due to military activity, can you accept deviation to the right?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 220 for 15nm, CES2701.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2701, turn right heading 220, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Right heading 220, wilco, CES2701.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CES2701, we have smoke coming from the avionics bay, we suspect an electrical fire. We are emergency descending to 4800m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES2701, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, emergency descent between DA and OBLIK, all aircraft below 8400m, leave the route to the south.

questions.question: How can CES2701 avoid the weather according to the pilot?

options.A: Deviate to the right side for 15nm.
options.B: Deviate to the left side for 40nm.
options.D: Deviate to the left side for 12nm.

questions.explanation: 飞行员请求 'request deviate to the left for 12nm'，即向左偏航 12 海里绕飞天气，故选 D。40nm 是天气距离，heading 220 飞 15nm 是后来改向右绕飞后的方案。

questions.question: Why can't CES2701 detour the weather from the left side?

options.B: Because there is a restricted area.
options.C: Because there is a prohibited area.

questions.explanation: 管制员否决向左偏航时说 'negative due to military activity'，明确原因是有军事活动，故选 A。对话中未提及限制区、禁区或冰雹。

questions.question: What happened to CES2701?

options.A: CES2701 encountered lightning strike and fuel leakage.
options.C: CES2701 had smoke from the avionics bay, suspected electrical fire.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 MAYDAY 时说 'we have smoke coming from the avionics bay, we suspect an electrical fire'，即电子设备舱冒烟、怀疑电气火警，故选 C。

questions.question: Where is CES2701 when he started emergency descent?

options.D: South of DA and OBLIK at 4800m.

questions.explanation: 管制员随后向全体广播 'emergency descent between DA and OBLIK'，而飞行员已宣布 'emergency descending to 4800m'，即开始紧急下降时位于 DA 与 OBLIK 之间、下降至 4800 米，故选 A。8400m 是要求其他飞机避让的高度界限。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CCA4718, 9nm final, established ILS, RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4718, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 145kts, report outer marker.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 145kts, report outer marker, CCA4718.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4718, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36R, wind 150, 8m/s, gusting up to 15m/s. QNH1008.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36R, QNH1008, thanks, CCA4718.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CCA4718, we had a tire burst on the right main gear during landing roll, the aircraft cannot move. Unable to vacate runway, request a tug to tow us back.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA4718, roger, tug is on the way. Break Break. DLH840, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied due to aircraft unable to vacate.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, DLH840.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, DLH840, we are now minimum fuel, request priority landing.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: DLH840, roger, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.2.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 124.2, DLH840.

questions.question: Why is CCA4718 unable to vacate the runway?

options.A: A tire burst on the main gear.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 'we had a tire burst on the right main gear during landing roll'，即着陆滑跑中右主起落架轮胎爆破导致无法脱离跑道，故选 A。

questions.question: What was the consequence of CCA4718's problem?

options.A: The aircraft skidded off the runway.
options.D: The aircraft was stuck on the runway and unable to move.

questions.explanation: 飞行员说 'the aircraft cannot move. Unable to vacate runway'，即飞机卡在跑道上无法移动，并导致 DLH840 复飞（runway occupied），故选 D。飞机并未冲出跑道，也未提及人员伤亡或起火。

questions.question: What was DLH840's request after the missed approach?

options.C: DLH840 requested priority landing due to minimum fuel.

questions.explanation: DLH840 复飞后报告 'we are now minimum fuel, request priority landing'，即因最低油量请求优先着陆，故选 C。124.2 是管制员让其联系的进近频率，并非 DLH840 主动请求。
